status.summary: Ping, latency, memory, CPU and whether each cog is healthy.

commands.description: Uptime, latency, memory, CPU, guilds and a five-row cog table.
commands.failures: If SQLite is unreachable the command still answers from the runtime cache and marks the database row degraded.

commands.description: The last N unhandled command errors: time, cog, command and exception type.
commands.failures: No rows means no unhandled error has been recorded since the database was created.

commands.description: Gateway, REST and database latency as three separate numbers.
commands.failures: A REST dash means the last API call has not completed yet; gateway latency comes from the heartbeat.

commands.description: Alias of /ping.
commands.failures: Same as /ping.

commands.description: Alias of /status.
commands.failures: Same as /status.

commands.description: Alias of /errors.
commands.failures: Same as /errors.

commands.description: Reload one cog after fixing a fault. Clears its faulted state on success.
commands.failures: A failed reload keeps the old fault row and returns the exception type; the bot stays online.

commands.description: Sync the command tree. Guild scope if DISCORD_DEV_GUILD_ID is set, global otherwise.
commands.failures: Discord throttles global syncs to once per hour; a 429 is reported, not retried in a loop.

commands.description: Attach a JSON export of settings, watches, pending announcements and opt-outs.
commands.failures: The export never includes tokens or nudge message bodies. Delivery is ephemeral and can exceed Discord's size limit only on pathological data.

commands.description: Stamp the renewal clock after renewing the host deployment.
commands.failures: If the clock is unset the dashboard says so rather than inventing a date.

commands.description: Close loops, the database and the process cleanly.
commands.failures: On a host with auto-restart the process comes back; use it for a clean config change, not to take the bot down permanently.

commands.description: Open the persistent, account-gated dashboard.
commands.failures: Sign in with Discord. Accounts and server grants are created by the bot owner; Discord permissions grant no dashboard access.

commands.description: Regenerate app/commands.json from the live command tree.
commands.failures: Refuses to write when a command has no entry in app/commands_docs.py.

settings.summary: Turn a cog off for maintenance, change guild config, read the audit log.

commands.description: List every cog with state, details and the toggle syntax.
commands.failures: A faulted cog shows its exception type and the reload command.

commands.description: The maintenance switch. Off pauses commands, loops and scheduled work; it deletes nothing.
examples: /settings cog dev off reason:Nudge abuse reports
commands.failures: Locked cogs (status, settings, utility) refuse with an explanation. Scheduled announcements are held, not cancelled.

commands.description: Read or change this server's text command prefix immediately. Bot mentions and slash commands remain available.
commands.failures: Custom prefixes require ENABLE_MESSAGE_CONTENT_INTENT=true and the portal's Message Content Intent. Use 1–16 visible characters, no spaces, mentions or leading /. reset restores mention-only commands; changes survive restarts and are audited.

commands.description: Read or set announce_channel, github_channel, mod_log, timezone and prefix.
commands.failures: A channel must be a text channel the bot can post in; a bad timezone or prefix is rejected before it is stored. Use prefix reset for mention-only text commands.

commands.description: Who changed what, when, and the reason they gave.
commands.failures: Rows older than AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS (90) are pruned daily; history after that point is genuinely gone.

github.summary: Watches a GitHub org or repo and posts grouped updates.

commands.description: Watch a whole org, one repo, or a pasted GitHub URL. Org watching covers every repo with one request.
commands.failures: Refuses at the 5-watch cap, on a duplicate target, on a 404 target, or when the channel cannot receive embeds.

commands.description: Every watch with target, channel, events, last poll, last delivery and health.
commands.failures: Health words are ok, quiet, stale, rate-limited and missing. A missing watch is not polled again until re-added.

commands.description: Post the most recent matching events once, to verify formatting and channel permissions.
commands.failures: Reports a missing channel, missing Embed Links, or an empty event feed without changing the cursor.

commands.description: Remove a watch. Its delivered history is kept in the audit log.
commands.failures: An unknown target is reported plainly; nothing else is touched.

dev.summary: Announcements to one fixed channel, and guarded nudge DMs.

commands.description: Post an embed to the one configured announcement channel.
examples: /dev announce title:"Maintenance tonight" body:"Back at 22:00 UTC."
commands.failures: Refuses when announce_channel is unset, when the bot lacks Send Messages or Embed Links, or when the title/body exceed 256/4000 characters.

commands.description: Schedule the same embed. Accepts in 2h, tomorrow 09:00, mon 09:00, 2026-11-01 18:00.
examples: /dev schedule when:"in 2h" title:"Maintenance" body:"Back at 22:00 UTC."
/dev schedule when:"tomorrow 09:00" title:"Standup" body:"In the voice channel."
commands.failures: Past times, unreadable times and the pending cap are refused before anything is stored. Pending rows survive a restart.

commands.description: The next five pending announcements with ids and local times.
commands.failures: An empty list says nothing is scheduled rather than showing a broken table.

commands.description: Cancel one pending announcement.
commands.failures: An already-sent or unknown id is refused; sent announcements are never deleted.

commands.description: Send one private DM on your behalf, with attribution and an opt-out hint.
examples: /dev nudge member:@maria message:"Can you review #43 before standup?"
commands.failures: Blocked by the 60 s pair cooldown, 5/hour author cap, 10/day target cap, opt-out, self-target, bots, or closed DMs. Closed DMs are reported plainly, not as an error.

commands.description: Stop receiving nudges from anyone.
commands.failures: Opt-out is global and immediate; a sender is told the target opted out.

commands.description: Allow nudges again.
commands.failures: Opting in does not clear past nudge counts or cooldowns.

utility.summary: Help links, about, invite and dashboard links.

commands.description: A button to live command docs, deep-linked to a cog page when one is given.
commands.failures: Docs are served on the bot's HTTP port. An unknown cog is rejected with the five valid names.

commands.description: Version, uptime, links and the host budget the bot runs inside.
commands.failures: Uptime resets on every restart; a shorter than expected uptime is an unplanned restart.

commands.description: Install link with the minimal permission integer.
commands.failures: Requires DISCORD_CLIENT_ID or an application info lookup; without either it says the invite URL is unavailable.

commands.description: Open the persistent dashboard at PUBLIC_BASE_URL/dashboard.
commands.failures: Signing in proves identity only. Access requires an active account and server grant from the owner; Manage Server grants nothing extra.
